regions.label: INesHeader

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Final PRG vector words: NMI $C01B, reset $C000, IRQ $C01B; validated handler code and startup CPU mapping.

regions.label: ChrTiles00
regions.evidence: iNES CHR-ROM storage: PPU-addressed 2-bit planar 8x8 tile patterns, separate immutable storage from CPU PRG. Fixed 16-byte pattern format; structural image classification, usage not exhaustively observed. All16 CHR banks sampled by immutable planar decoding (tiles0-15 and256-271 per8KiB bank): recognizable letters, numbers, units and terrain fragments; see analysis/round1/chr-bank-samples.png. This is structural bitmap storage, not exhaustive tile-use/reachability evidence.

regions.comment: Counted tile-coded field command messages and aliasing selector pointers.

Consumer AA4E/AA6F loads byte count and emits tile-coded message bytes, FF newline. Actual selected-unit/message displays confirm role; no claim every selector observed. See field-message-proof.json, field-AA rendering in contracts-interactions/static-contract-instructions.json.
